entries.raw: *[[2011 Syrian uprising]]: An [[Arab League]] observer witnesses [[sniper]]s in the [[Syria]]n city of [[Deraa]] and calls for their immediate removal. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2011/12/2011123164911825320.html (Al Jazeera)]
entries.text: 2011 Syrian uprising: An Arab League observer witnesses snipers in the Syrian city of Deraa and calls for their immediate removal.

entries.raw: *Two members of the outlawed [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] die in a battle with [[Law enforcement in Turkey|Turkish police]] in the city of [[Diyarbakir]]. [http://au.news.yahoo.com/thewest/a/-/world/12476347/two-kurdish-rebels-killed-in-southeastern-turkey/ (AFP via ''West Australian'')]
entries.text: Two members of the outlawed Kurdistan Workers' Party die in a battle with Turkish police in the city of Diyarbakir.

entries.raw: *[[Ethiopia]]n forces capture the central [[Somalia|Somali]] town of [[Beledweyne]] from [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[Islamist]] militants. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-16372453 (BBC)]
entries.text: Ethiopian forces capture the central Somali town of Beledweyne from al-Shabaab Islamist militants.

entries.raw: *The [[President of Sudan]] [[Omar Hassan al-Bashir]] urges members of the [[Darfur]] based [[Justice and Equality Movement]] (JEM) to seek peace following the recent death of rebel leader [[Ibrahim Khalil]]. [http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE7BU0FF20111231 (Reuters)]
entries.text: The President of Sudan Omar Hassan al-Bashir urges members of the Darfur based Justice and Equality Movement (JEM) to seek peace following the recent death of rebel leader Ibrahim Khalil.

entries.raw: *Nigerian unrest
entries.text: Nigerian unrest

entries.raw: **The [[President of Nigeria]] [[Goodluck Jonathan]] declares a [[state of emergency]] in the states of [[Borno State|Borno]], [[Yobe State|Yobe]], [[Niger State|Niger]] and [[Plateau State|Plateau]] due to violence by the [[Islamist]] sect [[Boko Haram]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2012-01-01/nigeria-declares-state-of-emergency/3753958 (AFP via ABC News Australia)]
entries.text: The President of Nigeria Goodluck Jonathan declares a state of emergency in the states of Borno, Yobe, Niger and Plateau due to violence by the Islamist sect Boko Haram.

entries.raw: **Clashes in [[Ebonyi State]] in eastern [[Nigeria]] kill at least fifty people. [http://old.news.yahoo.com/s/nm/20111231/wl_nm/us_nigeria_clashes (Reuters via Yahoo! News)]{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
entries.text: Clashes in Ebonyi State in eastern Nigeria kill at least fifty people. {{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}

entries.raw: **Nigeria shuts borders with the countries [[Cameroon]], [[Chad]], and [[Niger]]. [http://www.thenationonlineng.net/2011/index.php/news-update/31740-jonathan-declares-state-of-emergency-in-borno-yobe-plateau-and-niger-states.html (The Nation)][https://web.archive.org/web/20120107132718/http://www.sunnewsonline.com/webpages/news/national/2012/jan/01/national-01-01-2012-001.html (The Sun)]
entries.text: Nigeria shuts borders with the countries Cameroon, Chad, and Niger.

entries.raw: *Six thousand people from the [[Lou Nuer]] tribe in [[South Sudan]] attack the town of [[Pibor]] as a result of a dispute over [[cattle rustling]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-16375646 (BBC)]
entries.text: Six thousand people from the Lou Nuer tribe in South Sudan attack the town of Pibor as a result of a dispute over cattle rustling.

entries.raw: *Authorities in [[Chile]] close the [[Torres del Paine National Park]], amid an ongoing [[forest fire]] in [[Patagonia]]. [http://www.euronews.net/2011/12/30/wild-fires-devastate-chilean-patagonia/ (euronews)]
entries.text: Authorities in Chile close the Torres del Paine National Park, amid an ongoing forest fire in Patagonia.

entries.raw: *More than 200 people are injured by illegally huge [[firecracker]]s and celebratory gunfire in the [[Philippines]]. [http://www.iol.co.za/news/world/philippine-fireworks-injure-200-1.1206549 (IOL)]
entries.text: More than 200 people are injured by illegally huge firecrackers and celebratory gunfire in the Philippines.

entries.raw: *The death toll from [[Cyclone Thane]] in southern [[India]] rises to at least 33 with 21 people dead in [[Cuddalore]]. [http://au.news.yahoo.com/thewest/a/-/world/12476109/at-least-33-dead-in-south-india-cyclone-officials/ (AFP via Yahoo News)]
entries.text: The death toll from Cyclone Thane in southern India rises to at least 33 with 21 people dead in Cuddalore.

entries.raw: *A [[Chinese people|Chinese]] bus driver dies of [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|bird flu]] in the city of [[Shenzhen]] in [[Guangdong province]]. [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/china/2011-12/31/c_131337589.htm (Xinhua)]
entries.text: A Chinese bus driver dies of bird flu in the city of Shenzhen in Guangdong province.

entries.raw: *The [[United States]] announced that they will sell $30 billion in [[McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle]] fighter jets to [[Saudi Arabia]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2011/12/29/world/meast/u-s--saudi-fighter-sale/index.html?hpt=wo_c2 (CNN)]
entries.text: The United States announced that they will sell $30 billion in McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle fighter jets to Saudi Arabia.

entries.raw: *A 4.0-magnitude earthquake hits [[Ohio]], with no immediate reports of damage. [http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/45835151/ns/us_news-life/ (MSNBC)]
entries.text: A 4.0-magnitude earthquake hits Ohio, with no immediate reports of damage.

entries.raw: *In [[Hollywood, Los Angeles|Hollywood]], a string of 35 fires burned within 5 hours that caused at least $350,000 in damage. [http://www.cnn.com/2011/12/31/justice/california-arson/index.html?hpt=hp_t1 (CNN)]
entries.text: In Hollywood, a string of 35 fires burned within 5 hours that caused at least $350,000 in damage.

entries.raw: *The [[President of the United States]] [[Barack Obama]] signs a law providing for new [[International sanctions|sanctions]] against [[Iran]]. [http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5i8aDTUax9ph9ZF781ujYIn1Kr65w?docId=CNG.708e02122a0745a94d1e4949e69f7399.5f1 (AFP via Google News)]
entries.text: The President of the United States Barack Obama signs a law providing for new sanctions against Iran.

entries.raw: *[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Barack Obama]] signs the [[National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012|National Defense Authorization Act]] into law allowing the indefinite imprisonment of any [[United States citizen]] under suspect of [[terrorism]] without need of trial. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/erikkain/2012/01/02/president-obama-signed-the-national-defense-authorization-act-now-what/ (Forbes)]
entries.text: United States President Barack Obama signs the National Defense Authorization Act into law allowing the indefinite imprisonment of any United States citizen under suspect of terrorism without need of trial.

entries.raw: *[[Kim Jong-un]] is named as the Supreme Commander of [[North Korea]]'s armed forces following the death of his father [[Kim Jong-Il]]. [http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/kim-jong-un-named-supreme-commander-of-north-koreas-military/story-e6frg6so-1226233768751 (AP via ''The Australian'')]
entries.text: Kim Jong-un is named as the Supreme Commander of North Korea's armed forces following the death of his father Kim Jong-Il.

entries.raw: *[[NASA]] succeeds in putting the first of two [[Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory]] [[satellite]]s in orbit around the [[moon]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-16353839 (BBC)]
entries.text: NASA succeeds in putting the first of two Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory satellites in orbit around the moon.

entries.raw: *In [[motor sports]], [[WilliamsF1]] co-founder [[Patrick Head]] resigns as a director of the team after 34 years in [[Formula One]]. [http://www.autosport.com/news/report.php/id/96855 (''Autosport'')]
entries.text: In motor sports, WilliamsF1 co-founder Patrick Head resigns as a director of the team after 34 years in Formula One.
